instruction.text: Choose the correct conjunction to fill in the gap.

atoms.b: He loves playing football ((++but because)) he’s not very good at it.
I always take a shower ((++before because)) I go to bed.
Feel free to join us ((++if or)) you want to.
She brushed her teeth ((++after so)) she ate some sweets.
Priya was busy, ((++so because)) I had lunch on my own.
Scott should go to bed early, ((++or so)) he will be tired in the morning.
The test was hard, ((++but because)) it was fair.
Mary was late for work ((++because or)) she missed the bus.
